Definition: Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria
BiblicalUsage: Cuthah was one of the provinces of Assyria whose people were settled in Samaria after Israel was carried away. In 2 Kings 17:24 the king of Assyria brought men from Cuthah and placed them in the cities of Samaria, and in 2 Kings 17:30 the men of Cuth made Nergal, their own god, in the land.
TheologicalSignificance: What convinces me is that Cuthah is the warning of the whole chapter: a people moved into God's land brought their gods with them, and the land was filled with a mixture that was neither Israel nor Assyria.
